messages:
Nora: Tiny drop: we just crossed 200M inference requests this quarter!! :tada: Feeling proud and a little dizzy.
Chen: WHAT!!! That is insane. Mini parade? confetti cannons? :confetti_ball:
Priya: Parade sounds chaotic but effective. Can we do a 10-min "why this matters" lightning round + cupcakes?
Mateo: I volunteer to be parade MC. I have a foam crown and a kazoo. :crown: :trumpet:
Jordan: Huge congrats folks. Love the idea of a short town-hall + cupcakes. I can join for five minutes for a quick shoutout.
ops-bot: Reminder: production capacity check window at 20:00 — all green but flagged any last-minute concerns here.
Nora: @Jordan amazing, thanks. Plan: 3pm all-hands area, 10-min lightning, cupcakes, 1-min confetti pop, optional kazoo parade.
Chen: Also: sticker drop for remote folks and a tiny cardboard medal for in-office folks. Who wants to design? 
Priya: I can sketch a medal mock. Maybe our mascot with a little cape and "200M" on it.
Mateo: I will coordinate kazoos and recruit two people to do the chorus line (consent pending).
HR-Bot: RSVP request sent to calendar. If you need dietary accommodations for cupcakes, reply to this thread or DM @HR.
Nora: Thank you all. Huge shoutout to infra and model-onboarding for smoothing the last rollout. See you at 3pm — bring your party socks. :socks:
